cover.headline_html: 3 myths that stop small businesses cold.

myths.label: The Past-Performance Trap
myths.myth_text: You need past performance before you can win anything federal.
myths.reality_text: Teaming agreements let new shops piggyback on a prime's track record. Subcontracting builds your résumé while you earn. GSA Schedule approval only requires two years in business and documented commercial work — not prior federal awards.

myths.label: The Small Business Size Myth
myths.myth_text: GSA Schedule is built for big companies. Small shops don't stand a chance.
myths.reality_text: The majority of GSA Schedule holders are small businesses. The program was designed to give smaller companies direct access to federal buyers — no cold outreach, no prime standing between you and the work.

myths.label: The Commercial Price Mistake
myths.myth_text: Just charge what you charge your commercial clients and you're good.
myths.reality_text: GSA pricing requires a Basis of Award analysis. Price too high and you're uncompetitive. Negotiate it wrong and you're locked in for years. This is the most expensive first-timer mistake we see.

close.close_question: Drop the myth you believed when you first started exploring federal contracting.
